evidence.detail: Exact v308 recognizes @fla@, @fla2@, <fla>, <fla2>, parameterized <fla=...>/<fla2=...>, and the corresponding closing tags.
The effect stores injected timestamps and alternates the selected color/state on 200 ms intervals. Normal fla lifetime is 600 ms and fla2 lifetime is 1200 ms.

The fla2 path additionally derives a sinusoidal offset whose amplitude decays across the 1200 ms lifetime, proving the class owns the complete flashing/animated text effect rather than only tag parsing.
R55 RSFont invokes this class during live text layout/rendering and queries its active lifecycle state to continue redraws while the effect is running.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the live fla/fla2 flashing text animation used by RSFont.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 recognizes @type@, <type>, <type=...> and </type> markup in this class and strips/normalizes those tags for rendering.

Parameterized <type=N> clamps N to 10..2000 milliseconds; the class injects a current-time timestamp into rewritten markup and computes reveal progress from elapsed time divided by that per-character interval.

R55 RSFont calls this class while measuring and rendering text; Client and text-markup routing also retain the same instance/state, proving this is a live text-rendering effect rather than a parser utility with no consumer.
The instance records the effect end time and active flag, and exposes whether a typewriter effect remains active so redraws can continue until all visible characters have been revealed.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the timed <type> text reveal effect used by the font renderer.
